name: merchant-api

dependencies.name: payment-gateway
dependencies.description: Charges the customer's mobile money or card when a guest pays a payment request, and reports the resulting transaction status.

description: Owns merchants, payment requests, transactions and payouts. Verifies the merchant's signed-in identity for merchant-only operations, exposes an unauthenticated read/pay path for a guest completing a payment request, and calls the payment-gateway resource to process mobile money and card charges. Does not itself hold card/mobile-money credentials or move real funds — settlement is delegated entirely to the payment gateway.
